settings.title: System Configuration
settings.description: Manage local-first engine parameters and hardware links.
settings.syncDesc: Synchronize Merkle-Tries with local mesh peers.
settings.audioRetentionDesc: Persist audio files locally after transcription.
settings.jitsiBaaDesc2: and cannot be toggled off. Telehealth calls route
settings.jitsiBaaDesc3: to a self-hosted Jitsi server you configure below — never the public meet.jit.si. Each call also requires an explicit BAA acknowledgement on the Telehealth screen. These guarantees are non-optional by design.
settings.highContrastDesc: Force maximum contrast for field readability.
settings.showTickerDesc: Scrolling status bar at the top of the app.
settings.scrollSpeedDesc: Seconds per loop — lower is faster.
settings.noMessagesDesc: No messages — the ticker is hidden until you add one.
settings.telehealthDesc: Your self-hosted Jitsi domain. Telehealth routes only here — there is no public fallback. If this is empty, telehealth calls are disabled.
settings.telehealthDisabled: ✗ No server configured — telehealth is disabled.
settings.killSwitchDesc: Designate a USB token. If it is removed while armed, all vault keys are dropped from memory (references cleared; reclaimed by the runtime).
settings.noDevicesPrefix: No devices listed yet. Plug in your token and click
settings.backupDesc: Exports encrypted ciphertext only, HMAC-signed with your passphrase. Restore verifies the signature and refuses tampered files.
settings.auditLogDesc: Hash-chained record of every vault access (metadata only — no PHI). Editing or deleting any past entry breaks the chain.
settings.tamperingDetectedPrefix: ✗ TAMPERING DETECTED — chain breaks at entry #
settings.nukeDesc: Irreversibly delete all local storage and keys.
